description: Source code for the ResolveReferencesInAggregate class in Apache Spark, which resolves unresolved attributes in aggregate logical plans during query analysis.

classes.name: ResolveReferencesInAggregate
classes.description: A class that resolves unresolved attributes in aggregate logical plans during query analysis in Spark SQL.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method to resolve an Aggregate plan, handling resolution of grouping and aggregate expressions.

methods.name: resolveGroupByAlias
methods.description: Resolves GROUP BY aliases to select list expressions if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: resolveGroupByAll
methods.description: Handles the special case of GROUP BY ALL, expanding it to all non-aggregate columns.

methods.name: expandGroupByAll
methods.description: Infers grouping expressions from a GROUP BY ALL aggregate, returning optional list.

methods.name: isGroupByAll
methods.description: Checks if the grouping expressions represent a GROUP BY ALL clause.

methods.name: containsAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains an attribute outside aggregate expressions.

methods.name: checkUnresolvedGroupByAll
methods.description: Checks for unresolved GROUP BY ALL expressions at the end of analysis.
